parsed_output.deduplication_rule: Merge citations with identical normalized DOI values into a single entry, retaining the first encountered ID as the canonical reference.

workflow_steps.verification: Convert all DOI strings to lowercase and remove resolver prefixes (e.g., 'https://doi.org/') before comparison.
Group citations by normalized DOI value; flag groups with more than one member as duplicates.
Check each citation for null values in required metadata fields (doi, journal, year); record missing fields per citation ID.
Output duplicate groups and recommended canonical IDs based on the deduplication rule.

additional_controls: Log all normalization transformations for auditability.
Flag citations with multiple missing fields for manual review.
Maintain a mapping of original IDs to normalized entries for traceability.

hard_checks.check: missing journal and year on C4
